trial_court: Additional District Judge, Bandikui, District Dausa (Civil Misc. Case No.7/2016)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized around 12 years ago at Sri Ganganagar and out of the wedlock, one female child born. The respondent has deserted the petitioner and she was also maltreated for demand of dowry.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot harass the other party by filing multiple cases in different courts.
legal_principles.held: The respondent has filed three different cases against the petitioner, out of which two are pending adjudication at Dausa. It is contended that this Court in Criminal Misc. Transfer Petition No.07/2016 vide order dated 29.09.2016 directed to send record of Criminal Case No.535/2010 {State v. Mahendra Puri} to the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dausa and placed on record copy of order dated 29.09.2016 as Annex.R/1.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot use the court system to harass the other party by filing multiple transfer petitions.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner has filed this Transfer Petition. A copy of the order dated 03.02.2015 is also placed on record as Annex.R/3.

outcome.final_order: The matter is transferred to the Family Court, Sri Ganganagar.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on domestic violence cases under DV Act
preparing a transfer application for matrimonial disputes
